theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tpf_pse_support_of_mass_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (c : ℤ), Orthonormal ℝ τ → C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → C.massOn W = (c.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (W ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)))) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ C.massOn W ≠ 0) → C.support = (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
